def dns_query(server, name, qtype=1):
    tid = random.randint(0,65535)
    header = struct.pack(">HHHHHH", tid, 0x0100, 1, 0, 0, 0)
    q = b"".join(bytes([len(p)])+p.encode() for p in name.split(".")) + b"\x00"
    pkt = header + q + struct.pack(">HH", qtype, 1)
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM); s.settimeout(2)
    try:
        s.sendto(pkt, (server, 53))
        data, _ = s.recvfrom(4096)
        rcode = data[3] & 0xF
        ancount = struct.unpack(">H", data[6:8])[0]
        if rcode != 0: return f"rcode={rcode}"
        if ancount == 0: return "no answer"
        # skip question
        i = 12
        while data[i] != 0: i += data[i] + 1
        i += 5
        ips=[]
        for _ in range(ancount):
            # name (possibly pointer)
            if data[i] & 0xC0: i += 2
            else:
                while data[i] != 0: i += data[i]+1
                i += 1
            typ, cls, ttl, rdlen = struct.unpack(">HHIH", data[i:i+10]); i += 10
            if typ == 1 and rdlen == 4:
                ips.append(".".join(str(b) for b in data[i:i+4]))
            i += rdlen
        return ips or f"type={typ}"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"err {e}"
    finally: s.close()
